description: Runs a deterministic IELTS Writing structural, lexical, and register diagnostic on a learner's draft response (Task 2 Essay, Academic Task 1 Report, or General Training Task 1 Letter). Checks word count penalties, paragraph balance, Task 1 Overview presence, GT salutation/sign-off pairing, contraction violations, overused mechanical linkers, and lexical variety.

draftText.description: The learner's full draft essay, report, or letter text.

letterTone.description: Optional target tone when taskType is 'gt_task_1' (defaults to 'formal').

taskType.description: The IELTS Writing task type being analyzed.

name: analyze_writing_structure
title: Analyze IELTS Writing Structure & Register
